== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1685. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-3117|John Glasgow]] and [[Purves-614|Margaret Purves]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3117]] is assessed at 87% (probable). Captured account assigns Margaret's 3 March 1685 Duns index to daughter of John Glasgow and Margaret Purves. The full John/Margaret Purves couple and Duns household match the selected father’s adult family. The 1666 Gordon childhood is nearby and chronologically feasible at about nineteen.

Probable full-profile continuity, with the named household paternity distinguished from the earlier Gordon-child identification; Duns and Gordon are not silently treated as identical birthplaces.

Next useful test: Compare the Purves marriage and witnesses with the Gordon family.
